questionText:
Consider the following context-free grammar where the start symbol is $S$ and the set of terminals is \{a,b,c,d\}.

$$S \rightarrow AaAb \mid BbBa$$
$$A \rightarrow cS \mid \epsilon$$
$$B \rightarrow dS \mid \epsilon$$

The following is a partially-filled LL(1) parsing table.

$a$$b$$c$$d$$\$
$S$$S \rightarrow AaAb$$S \rightarrow BbBa$(1)(2)
$A$$A \rightarrow \epsilon$(3)$A \rightarrow cS$
$B$(4)$B \rightarrow \epsilon$$B \rightarrow dS$

Which one of the following options represents the CORRECT combination for the numbered cells in the parsing table?

Note: In the options, “blank” denotes that the corresponding cell is empty.
explanation:
To fill the LL(1) parsing table, we calculate the FIRST and FOLLOW sets for the non-terminals:

1. FIRST Sets:
• $\text{FIRST}(A) = \{c, \epsilon\}$
• $\text{FIRST}(B) = \{d, \epsilon\}$
• $\text{FIRST}(AaAb) = (\text{FIRST}(A) \setminus \{\epsilon\}) \cup \text{FIRST}(aAb) = \{c, a\}$
• $\text{FIRST}(BbBa) = (\text{FIRST}(B) \setminus \{\epsilon\}) \cup \text{FIRST}(bBa) = \{d, b\}$

2. Filling Table Entries for $S$:
• Production $S \rightarrow AaAb$ is placed in $M[S, a]$ and $M[S, c]$. Hence, cell (1) under column $c$ is $S \rightarrow AaAb$.
• Production $S \rightarrow BbBa$ is placed in $M[S, b]$ and $M[S, d]$. Hence, cell (2) under column $d$ is $S \rightarrow BbBa$.

3. FOLLOW Sets & $\epsilon$-productions:
• For $A \rightarrow \epsilon$, entries are added to $M[A, x]$ for all $x \in \text{FOLLOW}(A)$.
• From $S \rightarrow AaAb$, the terminal $a$ follows the first $A$ and terminal $b$ follows the second $A$, so $\{a, b\} \subseteq \text{FOLLOW}(A)$.
• Thus, $A \rightarrow \epsilon$ goes into $M[A, a]$ and $M[A, b]$. Hence, cell (3) under column $b$ is $A \rightarrow \epsilon$.
• From $S \rightarrow BbBa$, the terminal $b$ follows the first $B$ and terminal $a$ follows the second $B$, so $\{a, b\} \subseteq \text{FOLLOW}(B)$.
• Thus, $B \rightarrow \epsilon$ goes into $M[B, b]$ and $M[B, a]$. Hence, cell (4) under column $a$ is $B \rightarrow \epsilon$.

Therefore, Option (A) is correct.
